patterns.prefix: Failed to resolve content at path:

trigger.condition: One of the four declared activities fails to resolve ItemSignal content at DefaultPath, which current source sets to %.@.

likelyCauses.text: The selected ItemSignal does not resolve content at the current fixed %.@ default path.

diagnostics.action: Confirm the canonical activity and anchored log; inspect only ItemSignal %.@ presence/resolution flags, not content or the variable path text.
diagnostics.expected: Source-branch and redacted type/presence/parse-status flags discriminate the documented pattern without exposing content or exception text.

correction.boundary: Operator proposal for the originating format input/Plan only after the cited guard is confirmed; do not execute provider/runtime work or store variable log text.

steps.action: If the intended content is absent at %.@, correct the originating ItemSignal/source mapping to provide it there; do not invent content or edit an unused Plan.Path.
steps.expected: The intended local input satisfies the confirmed guard; no live formatting result is claimed.

stopWhen: The error matches only a broad wrapper without confirmed guard, source identity changed, or intended content/mode is unknown.

verification.action: Statically confirm the intended ItemSignal content resolves at %.@ before the activity helper runs.
verification.expected: The confirmed local source guard is false or parser accepts the intended content; runtime success remains unverified.

entries.redaction: Exclude full ItemSignal/Plan, JSON/XML/text content, path or file bytes, provider data, credentials and the variable middle of the error log; retain only canonical adapter/activity, pattern identity and presence/type/local parse-status flags.
limitations: Source-only confidence; no runtime formatter/provider execution was performed.
The anchored pattern never captures or retains its variable middle segment.
Current source assigns DefaultPath=%.@; the pattern is retained for source-bound variable logging, not arbitrary path selection.
